title.value: Modality Translation for Object Detection Adaptation Without Forgetting Prior Knowledge
title.justification: The title clearly reflects the focus of the paper, which is the development of a method called Modality Translator (ModTr) for adapting object detection models across different modalities without losing the pre-trained knowledge.
title.quote: This paper focuses on adapting a large object detection model trained on RGB images to new data extracted from IR images with a substantial modality shift.

analysis.description: The paper introduces Modality Translator (ModTr), a novel approach to adapt object detection models trained on RGB images for use with IR images, thus preventing the loss of pre-trained knowledge. ModTr is a small transformation network that performs image-to-image translation, allowing the original detector to function on the new modality without fine-tuning. The effectiveness of ModTr is demonstrated on datasets with RGB and IR image pairs.

type.justification: The paper proposes a new method (Modality Translator) and discusses its theoretical basis for adapting object detectors without altering the pre-trained model, supported by empirical results.
type.quote: A common practice in deep learning involves training large neural networks on massive datasets to achieve high accuracy across various domains and tasks.
